Appearance:
 Ms. Savita Rathore - Advocate for the petitioner.
 Shri K. K. Tiwari - G.A. for respondent No.1/State.
 Shri Sachin Parmar - Advocate for the complainant.
ORDER 1] Heard finally with the consent of the parties.

2] This petition has been filed by the petitioner under Section 482 of Cr.P.C./Section 528 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for quashment of FIR bearing Crime No.257/2025 for the offence punishable under Sections 498-A,
376, 366, 377, 370 and 506 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, registered at Police Station Kanwan,
District Dhar, and all other consequential proceedings arising out of the said crime number.
3] Counsel for the petitioner, at the outset, has submitted that the parties have settled their disputes out of the Court.
Complainant has also filed an application (I.A. No.12835 of 2025) under Section 359(2) of B.N.S.S., 2023 read with Section 320(2) of Cr.P.C regarding the compromise.
It is also submitted that no purpose would be served to keep the matter pending when the matter is already compromised, and in such circumstances, the petition may be allowed.

4] Counsel for the respondent No.2 has submitted that he has no objection if NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-IND:25447 2 MCRC-40323-2025 the FIR is quashed.
5] Counsel for the respondent/State has submitted that appropriate order may be passed.

6] Having considered rival submissions, perusal of the documents filed on record, as also the Abhimanyu Singh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 8 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/118266533/

sentences.text: 1 application filed by the complainant, this Court has no hesitation to allow the present petition.
7] Accordingly, I.A. No.12835 of 2025 stands allowed and disposed of.

8] Resultantly, the petition is hereby allowed, and the FIR bearing Crime No.257/2025 for the offence punishable under Sections 498-A, 376, 366, 377, 370 and 506 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, registered at Police Station Kanwan, District Dhar, and all other consequential proceedings arising out of the said crime number, pending against the petitioner, are hereby quashed.
9] Accordingly, the petition stands allowed and disposed of.
